theme: Light mode default, deep charcoal dark mode

typography.font_family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

card.classes: bg-[#FFFFFF] dark:bg-[#2A2A2A] border border-[#E8E5DD] dark:border-[#3A3A3A] rounded-[12px] p-4 shadow-sm
card.notes: Surface cards use 12px border radius. No heavy shadows.

button_primary.classes: bg-[#1A8A7D] text-[#FAFAF8] rounded-[8px] min-h-[44px] px-4 py-2 font-medium flex items-center justify-center transition-colors hover:bg-[#146F64] dark:hover:bg-[#20A596]
button_primary.notes: 8px border radius. Minimum 44px height for touch targets.

button_secondary.classes: bg-transparent text-[#2D2D2A] dark:text-[#F0F0F0] border border-[#E8E5DD] dark:border-[#3A3A3A] rounded-[8px] min-h-[44px] px-4 py-2 font-medium flex items-center justify-center transition-colors hover:bg-[#FAFAF8] dark:hover:bg-[#1A1A1A]

input.classes: w-full bg-[#FFFFFF] dark:bg-[#2A2A2A] border border-[#E8E5DD] dark:border-[#3A3A3A] rounded-[8px] min-h-[44px] px-3 py-2 text-[16px] text-[#2D2D2A] dark:text-[#F0F0F0] placeholder-[#6B6B66] dark:placeholder-[#A0A09F] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#1A8A7D]
input.notes: 16px text prevents iOS zoom on focus. 8px border radius.

bottom_nav.container_classes: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-[56px] bg-[#FAFAF8] dark:bg-[#1A1A1A] border-t border-[#E8E5DD] dark:border-[#3A3A3A] flex justify-around items-center z-50
bottom_nav.item_active: text-[#1A8A7D] flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-full
bottom_nav.item_inactive: text-[#6B6B66] dark:text-[#A0A09F] flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-full

pillar_tag.classes: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-[12px] text-[12px] font-medium border min-h-[24px]

motion.philosophy: No animations except subtle transitions for state changes (hover, focus, active).

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Use kebab-case, role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='journal-submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first responsive layout suitable for mobile browsers or PWA.
Implement the Bottom Navigation bar globally, fixing it to the bottom with 56px height.
Ensure all touch targets (buttons, inputs, clickable icons) are at least 44x44px.
Use system fonts exactly as specified. Do not import external fonts like Inter or Roboto.
For the Journal HOME screen, structure 5 text fields with auto-save utilizing localforage/IndexedDB.
Implement the Pillar tags as toggleable chips with their respective hex colors.
Apply the color variables strictly. The app should feel calm, minimal, and academic.
Add data-testid to every interactive component for testing.
Use Recharts for the 4-week bar chart in the Progress module.
Ensure dark mode toggle works and maps exactly to the dark mode hex codes provided.
